boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named stops on SJNY’s official Brooklyn Campus map, with practical ways to recognize and navigate the compact Clinton Hill campus.

cards.title: St. Angela Hall
cards.subtitle: 263 Waverly Avenue, Brooklyn Campus
cards.notes: Use the official address to place this building on your route before meeting classmates nearby; confirm room-specific access through the University.
cards.short_summary: A named Brooklyn Campus building on Waverly Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY’s Brooklyn Campus map lists St. Angela Hall at 263 Waverly Avenue.
cards.access_notes: The map identifies the building; room access is not specified.

cards.title: Burns Hall Parlors
cards.subtitle: Burns Hall, 245 Clinton Avenue
cards.notes: Check event details for the parlors when planning a reading or meeting, and use the Clinton Avenue address as your arrival point.
cards.short_summary: A campus building whose parlors have hosted a Brooklyn Writers Foundry reading.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY reported that the Brooklyn Writers Foundry gathered in the Burns Hall Parlors for a reading event.
cards.source_title: St. Joseph's University, New York — Brooklyn Campus
cards.access_notes: Event and room access depend on the University’s scheduling.

cards.title: Tuohy Hall
cards.subtitle: 245 Clinton Avenue, Brooklyn Campus
cards.notes: Use this named Clinton Avenue building as a clear wayfinding point when coordinating a campus meet-up; verify the room and access first.
cards.short_summary: A named academic and student-services building on the Brooklyn Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY’s Brooklyn Campus map lists Tuohy Hall at 245 Clinton Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Student Accessibility Services and Student Success Services are listed in Tuohy Hall; room access varies.

cards.title: Lorenzo Hall
cards.subtitle: 265 Clinton Avenue, Brooklyn Campus
cards.notes: If you have a mathematics, computer science, nursing, psychology, or social-sciences question, verify the faculty room before heading here.
cards.short_summary: A campus building used by several Brooklyn academic departments.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY faculty pages place Brooklyn mathematics and computer science faculty on Lorenzo Hall’s first floor.
cards.source_title: Mathematics and Computer Science Faculty — Brooklyn Campus
cards.access_notes: Faculty office availability and building access vary by schedule.

cards.title: St. Joseph’s Hall
cards.subtitle: 256 Clinton Avenue, Brooklyn Campus
cards.notes: Save the official address for a precise campus rendezvous, especially when moving between the Clinton Avenue buildings; confirm destination details in advance.
cards.short_summary: A named SJNY Brooklyn Campus building on Clinton Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY’s Brooklyn Campus map lists St. Joseph’s Hall at 256 Clinton Avenue.
cards.access_notes: The map identifies the building; public or room access is not specified.

cards.title: The Molloy Theatre
cards.subtitle: 265 Clinton Avenue, Brooklyn Campus
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled University performance or event before visiting, then use the mapped Clinton Avenue address to find the theatre entrance.
cards.short_summary: A named campus theatre building on Clinton Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY’s Brooklyn Campus map lists The Molloy Theatre at 265 Clinton Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Access depends on scheduled events and University policies.

cards.title: Dillon Child Center
cards.subtitle: 239 Vanderbilt Avenue, Brooklyn Campus
cards.notes: Education students can ask their program about observation opportunities; do not enter or arrange a visit without the center’s authorization.
cards.short_summary: The campus child-study site used for education-focused observation.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY described the Dillon Child Study Center as an on-site preschool where child study majors begin observations in their freshman year.
cards.source_title: SJC Brooklyn Hosts Celebrating Teaching Event
cards.access_notes: A child center; access requires authorization and is not a drop-in visitor activity.

cards.title: Founder’s Hall
cards.subtitle: 232 Clinton Avenue, Brooklyn Campus
cards.notes: Use the mapped address as a concrete check-in point when crossing campus, and confirm your room or appointment before entering.
cards.short_summary: A named Brooklyn Campus building on Clinton Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY’s Brooklyn Campus map lists Founder’s Hall at 232 Clinton Avenue.
cards.access_notes: The map identifies the building; public or room access is not specified.

cards.title: McEntegart Hall Library
cards.subtitle: 222 Clinton Avenue, Brooklyn Campus
cards.notes: Bring a valid SJNY ID, use the library’s research tools, and check its calendar before you go; access is limited to current campus members.
cards.short_summary: The Brooklyn library and home of the Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY states that its libraries are open to current students, faculty, and staff presenting a valid University ID.
cards.source_title: St. Joseph's University, New York Brooklyn Library
cards.access_notes: Current students, faculty, and staff need a valid SJNY ID; consult the library calendar for hours.

cards.title: The Hill Center
cards.subtitle: 212 Vanderbilt Avenue, Brooklyn Campus
cards.notes: Plan a recreation or fitness visit around the facility’s reservation and ID requirements, and follow posted rules while using the athletic spaces.
cards.short_summary: SJNY’s athletic facility with courts, fitness equipment, and an outdoor terrace.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY says the Hill Center is available to students, faculty, and staff and includes basketball and volleyball courts, a fitness center, and an outdoor terrace.
cards.access_notes: Valid SJNY ID is required; fitness-center and open-gym use may require a reservation.
